Joe Vogel, a Democrat from Montgomery County who joined the General Assembly in 2023, is taking aim at the longtime legislative perk with a bill that would bar lobbyists, corporations and special interest groups from taking lawmakers out on the town.During the Maryland General Assembly’s 90-day legislative session this year,energy companies like Baltimore Gas and Electric, Constellation, Washington Gas and PEPCO combined to spend more than $49,000 wining-and-dining the very lawmakers who we
title: VOGEL INTRODUCES BAN TO LOBBYIST FUNDED COMMITTEE DINNERS
